errors.evidence: The description states there are six categories, but the legend clearly lists seven distinct financial instruments that are represented in the stacked bars.
The color for the 'Акции на АДСИЦ' segment is brown, not dark red ('тъмночервен'). The human reference correctly identifies this color as 'кафяво' (brown).

errors.text_span: като „Други“ (червен) са разположени върху всички останали
errors.evidence: This phrasing is awkward and misleadingly suggests that the 'Други' (Other) category has a different structural role than the other segments. It is simply the top segment in the stacked bar, not something placed 'on top of all the others' in a special way.

The bar for 2014 reaches a value very close to 120,000 (approximately 118,000). Describing this as 'over 110,000' is an understatement and less precise than what can be observed. The reference description more accurately states it is 'close to 120,000'.
